English Translation: The Most Serene Prince makes known, and it is by deliberation of the Most Illustrious Rectors against blasphemy, appointed by the Most Excellent Council of Ten, that no person, of whatever rank, status, or condition they may be, shall dare to play any imaginable kind of game, that is, with ball, balloon, cards, dice, crossbow, pandolo, or any other kind that can be named, around the Church or Monastery of the Reverend Nuns of SAN GIEROLEMO, nor in contiguous places to it, and their houses, or in boats. And this under penalty of banishment, galley servitude, prison, whipping, and fifty ducats, to be given, half to the accuser, who shall be kept secret, and the other half to the captors who shall make the apprehension. Nor, in said places, shall one make tumult, make noise, nor speak obscene words, blaspheme, nor commit any impurity. All of which things must be inviolably observed by everyone, and under the aforementioned penalties for those who contravene. On the 6th day of September 1628. Published at SAN GIEROLEMO on the fondamenta near the GANASSA Bridge, Commander.
Italian Translation: Il Serenissimo Principe fa sapere, ed è per deliberazione degli Illustrissimi Rettori contro la bestemmia, eletti dall'Eccelso Consiglio di X, che non vi sia alcuna persona, di qualsivoglia grado, stato o condizione essa sia, che ardisca giocare a gioco di qualsivoglia sorta immaginabile, cioè a palla, pallone, carte, dadi, quadrello, pandolo, oppure di qualsivoglia altra sorte che dir si possa, attorno la Chiesa o Monastero delle Reverendissime Monache di SAN GIEROLEMO, nemmeno in luoghi contigui ad esso e sue case, e nelle barche. E questo in pena di bando, galea, prigione, frusta e cinquanta ducati, da essere dati la metà all'accusatore, il quale sarà tenuto segreto, e l'altra metà ai captori che faranno la ritenzione. Nemmeno in detti luoghi tumultuare, strepitare, né dire parole oscene, bestemmiare, né fare alcuna immondizia. Le quali tutte cose dovrà da ciascuno essere osservate inviolabilmente, e sotto alle pene suddette a quelli che contravverranno. Addì 6 Settembre 1628. Pubblicata a SAN GIEROLEMO sulla fondamenta presso il Ponte della GANASSA, Comandador.

Morì il 4 marzo dell'anno del Signore 1648, all'età di 78 anni. Antonius de Sgobbis, addolorato, pose questo per il benemerito, un eterno monumento di animo grato.

CHE ALCVNO COSÌ HVOMO COMME DONNA NON ARDISCA DI FABRICAR / O DI
FAR FABRICAR VENDER O FAR VENDER PANE DI FARINA DI FORMENTO / IN QVAL
SI SIA LVOGO DELLA CITTÀ COSÌ FORESTO COME CASALINO / NELLE CASE NE IN
BARCHE NE PER LE STRADE ALLA PORTA DI GHETTO / RIVA DELL’OGLIO SANTI
APOSTOLI NE IN ALTRI LVOGHI DELLA CITTÀ / IN PENA DI CORDA PREGGION
GALERA E DE DVCATI VENTICINQVE / PER CADAVNO OGNI VOLTA CHE CONTRA-
FACESSERO LA METTÀ DE / QVALI SV DE MINISTRI CHE FACESSERO LE RETENTIO-
NI DELLI REI OLTRE / LA METÀ DEL PANE E DVCATI CINQVE DALL’ARTE DE PISTO-
RI NE / POSSINO VSCIR DI PREGGIONE LI RETENTI SE NON HAVERANNO VNA /
FEDE DAL GASTALDO SVDETTO CHE SV STATA REINTEGRATA L’ / ARTE DELLI
DVCATI CINQVE ESBORSATI E SE SI TROVASSERO TRANSGR / ESORI LI FORNERI
CADINO IN PENA DVPLICATA GIÀ DECRETATA.
LI PVTTI DI ETÀ NON OTTIMA POSSINO ESSER RETENTI E POSTI / PER MOZZI SOPRA
LE PVBLICHE NAVI E S’INTENDANO INCORSI E SOT / TOPOSTI A TVTTE LE PENE
SOPRADETTE QVELLI CHE LI HAVESSERO / MANDATI A VENDER DETTO PANE. /
SE ALCVNO ARDISSE DI TEMERARIAMENTE OSTARE ALLE RETENTION / I E REI O
ALL’ASPORTO DEL PANE S’INTENDI CADVTO E SOCCOMBENTE / ALLE PENE
MEDESIME DE DELINQVENTI E POSSINO TANTO GL’VNI / QVANTO OGN’ALTRO
ESSER RETENTI DA OGNI CAPITANIO / CON LI PREMII SOPRADETTI.
POSSINO PVRE ESSER RETENTI LI MAGAZENIERI OSTI E QVEI DELLE / CAMERE
LOCANDE CHE TENESSERO PAN FORESTIER OD OGNI ALTRO / LVOGO FVORI DA
QVEI PISTORI CHE FVSSERO OBBLIGATI A RICEVERLO / SEMPRE SEGNATO E MAR-
CATO GIVSTO ALL’OBBLIGO DELI STESSI / E NON ESSENDO CON TALI REQVESITI
S’INTENDI SEMPRE PER CONTRA / BANDO E LI MEDESIMI SOGGIETI ALLE SOPRA-
DETTE PENE.
LI BARCAROLI CHE CONDVCESSERO PANE IN QVESTA CITTÀ E LE / VASSERO PER-
SONE CHE NE PORTASSERO CADINO NELLA PENA DE / DVCATI VENTICINQVE ED
ESSERLI ABBRVCIATA LA BARCA E S’ / INTENDINO BANDITI PER ANNI DVE DA
QVEL TRAGHETTO IN / CVI ESERCITASSERO LA LIBERTÀ.
SIA IL PRESENTE PROCLAMA STAMPATO PVBLICATO ET INCISO / IN MARMO ALLA
PORTA DEL GHETTO RIVA DELL’OGLIO SANTI / APOSTOLI SAN MARTIN ET ALTRI
LVOGHI PIÙ FREQVENTATI DA / CONTRAFACIENTI ACCIO RESTI PRESTATA L’INTIE-
RA OBBEDIENZA / ALLO STESO NE POSSA ESSER ADOTTO PRETESTO D’IGNORAN-
ZA / PER VENIRE IN LVME DE REI SI ACCETTARANNO DENONCIE SECRETE / E SI
FORMERÀ PROCESSO PER VIA D’INQVISITIONE CONTRO SIMILI CON / TRAFATTO-
RI ONDE SI ESTIRPI VN DISORDINE SI PERNITIOSO NON SOLO / ALL’INTERESSE
DEL PVBLICO CHE A QVELO DEL’ARTE DE PISTORI.

English Translation:
SUPREME COMMAND
4 NOVEMBER 1918
THE WAR AGAINST AUSTRIA-HUNGARY WHICH, UNDER THE HIGH LEADERSHIP OF H.M. THE KING, SUPREME LEADER OF THE ITALIAN ARMY, INFERIOR IN NUMBERS AND RESOURCES, BEGAN ON 24 MAY 1915 AND, WITH UNSHAKEABLE FAITH AND TENACIOUS VALOR, WAS FOUGHT UNINTERRUPTEDLY AND WITH UTMOST FEROCITY FOR 41 MONTHS, IS WON. THE GIGANTIC BATTLE JOINED ON THE 24TH OF LAST OCTOBER, AND IN WHICH 51 ITALIAN, 3 BRITISH, 2 FRENCH, 1 CZECHOSLOVAK DIVISIONS AND 1 AMERICAN REGIMENT TOOK PART AGAINST 73 AUSTRO-HUNGARIAN DIVISIONS, IS CONCLUDED. THE LIGHTNING-FAST AND EXTREMELY DARING ADVANCE OF THE 29TH ARMY CORPS ON TRENTO, BLOCKING THE RETREAT ROUTES OF THE ENEMY ARMIES IN THE TRENTINO – OVERWHELMED TO THE WEST BY THE TROOPS OF THE SEVENTH ARMY AND TO THE EAST BY THOSE OF THE FIRST, SIXTH, AND FOURTH – DETERMINED YESTERDAY THE TOTAL COLLAPSE OF THE ADVERSARY FRONT FROM THE BRENTA TO THE TORRE; THE IRRESISTIBLE SURGE OF THE TWELFTH, EIGHTH, AND TENTH ARMIES AND THE CAVALRY DIVISIONS CONTINUES TO DRIVE THE FLEEING ENEMY FURTHER AND FURTHER BACK INTO THE PLAIN. H.R.H. THE DUKE D'AOSTA RAPIDLY ADVANCES AT THE HEAD OF HIS UNDEFEATED THIRD ARMY, EAGER TO RETURN TO THE POSITIONS IT HAD ALREADY VICTORIOUSLY CONQUERED, WHICH IT HAD NEVER LOST. THE AUSTRO-HUNGARIAN ARMY IS ANNIHILATED; IT SUFFERED EXTREMELY HEAVY LOSSES IN THE FIERCE RESISTANCE OF THE FIRST DAYS, AND IN THE PURSUIT, IT LOST IMMENSE QUANTITIES OF ALL TYPES OF MATERIAL AND ALMOST ENTIRELY ITS WAREHOUSES AND DEPOTS. IT HAS LEFT IN OUR HANDS SO FAR APPROXIMATELY THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND PRISONERS, INCLUDING ENTIRE GENERAL STAFFS, AND NO FEWER THAN FIVE THOUSAND CANNONS. THE REMNANTS OF WHAT WAS ONCE ONE OF THE WORLD'S MOST POWERFUL ARMIES ARE RETREATING IN DISORDER AND WITHOUT HOPE UP THE VALLEYS THEY HAD DESCENDED WITH PROUD CERTAINTY.
DIAZ
Italian Translation:
COMANDO SUPREMO
4 NOVEMBRE 1918
LA GUERRA CONTRO L’AUSTRIA-UNGHERIA CHE, SOTTO L’ALTA GUIDA DI S.M. IL RE DUCE SUPREMO L’ESERCITO ITALIANO, INFERIORE PER NUMERO E PER MEZZI, INIZIÒ IL 24 MAGGIO 1915 E CON FEDE INCROLLABILE E TENACE VALORE CONDUSSE, ININTERROTTA ED ASPRISSIMA PER 41 MESI È VINTA. LA GIGANTESCA BATTAGLIA INGAGGIATA IL 24 DELLO SCORSO OTTOBRE ED ALLA QUALE PRENDEVANO PARTE 51 DIVISIONI ITALIANE, 3 BRITANNICHE, 2 FRANCESI, 1 CZECOSLOVACCA ED 1 REGGIMENTO AMERICANO CONTRO 73 DIVISIONI AUSTRO-UNGARICHE È FINITA. LA FULMINEA ARDITISSIMA AVANZATA DEL 29 CORPO D’ARMATA SU TRENTO SBARRANDO LE VIE DELLA RITIRATA ALLE ARMATE NEMICHE DEL TRENTINO TRAVOLTE AD OCCIDENTE DALLE TRUPPE DELLA SETTIMA ARMATA E AD ORIENTE DA QUELLE DELLA PRIMA, SESTA E QUARTA, HA DETERMINATO IERI LO SFACELO TOTALE DELLA FRONTE AVVERSARIA DAL BRENTA AL TORRE; L’IRRESISTIBILE SLANCIO DELLA DODICESIMA, DELL’OTTAVA, DELLA DECIMA ARMATA E DELLE DIVISIONI DI CAVALLERIA RICACCIA SEMPRE PIÙ INDIETRO IL NEMICO FUGGENTE NELLA PIANURA. S.A.R IL DUCA D’AOSTA AVANZA RAPIDAMENTE ALLA TESTA DELLA SUA INVITTA TERZA ARMATA ANELANTE DI RITORNARE SULLE POSIZIONI DA ESSA GIÀ VITTORIOSAMENTE CONQUISTATE, CHE MAI AVEVA PERDUTE. L’ESERCITO AUSTRO-UNGARICO È ANNIENTATO, ESSO HA SUBITO PERDITE GRAVISSIME NELLA ACCANITA RESISTENZA DEI PRIMI GIORNI E NELL’INSEGUIMENTO HA PERDUTE QUANTITÀ INGENTISSIME DI MATERIALE DI OGNI SORTA E PRESSOCHÉ PER INTERO I SUOI MAGAZZINI E I DEPOSITI. HA LASCIATO FINORA NELLE NOSTRE MANI CIRCA TRECENTOMILA PRIGIONIERI CON INTERI STATI MAGGIORI E NON MENO DI CINQUEMILA CANNONI. I RESTI DI QUELLO CHE FU UNO DEI PIÙ POTENTI ESERCITI DEL MONDO RISALGONO IN DISORDINE E SENZA SPERANZA LE VALLI CHE AVEVANO DISCESO CON ORGOGLIOSA SICUREZZA.
DIAZ

English Translation:
The Most Serene Prince hereby makes known, and it is by resolution of the Most Illustrious and Most Excellent Lords Inquisitors and Revisors over the Grand Schools:
THAT no confrere of the GRAND SCHOOL OF ST. MARK THE EVANGELIST, beneficiary of the AMORE DEI Commission of the late PIETRO OLIVIERI, from any of the 24 HOUSES belonging to said Commission, located in the courtyard called ST. MARK in the district of ANGELO RAFFAEL, who, abusing the charitable assistance granted to him by the Commissioners, should dare, against the laws of the PRINCE and of the TESTATOR, to rent either all or in part any of the said houses, nor under any guise or pretext introduce therein foreign persons to inhabit them, which houses, in accordance with the aforesaid laws, must be inhabited by favored persons only; it being understood that transgressors who should rent, introduce, or not inhabit the same, will not only be immediately deprived of the house itself, but also subject to all those other afflictive penalties that shall be deemed appropriate by their Most Excellent Lordships.
As also, that there may not be any person, of whatever rank and condition, who should dare, under any pretext, to introduce themselves and remain in said courtyard called ST. MARK, to there play any kind of game, whisper, make noise, stamp, or in any other way disturb the inhabitants of the same courtyard; with penalty for those who transgress of imprisonment, torture, whipping, galley service, pillory, and others at the discretion of JUSTICE; with a reward to the accuser, who shall be kept secret, of two hundred small LIRA from the goods of the guilty party. And because it is as pious as it is the resolute will of their Excellencies that the present proclamation remain entirely obeyed in all its parts, the disobedient shall be irremediably punished.
Given by the aforementioned Most Excellent Magistracy on the 13th SEPTEMBER 1759.
ZVANNE TIEPOLO Inquisitor Reviser
LORENZO GRIMANI Inquisitor Reviser
ANDREA DIEDO Inquisitor Reviser
LAVRO BARTOLINI Secretary
Italian Translation:
Il Serenissimo Principe fa sapere, ed è per deliberazione degli Illustrissimi ed Eccellentissimi Signori Inquisitori e Revisori sopra le Scuole Grandi:
Che non vi sia alcun confratello della SCUOLA GRANDE DI SAN MARCO EVANGELISTA, beneficiato dall'AMORE DEI della COMMISSARIA del quondam PIETRO OLIVIERI, di alcuna delle 24 CASE di ragione di essa COMMISSARIA situate nella CORTE detta di SAN MARCO in CONTRADA DELL’ANGELO RAFFAEL, che, abusando del caritatevole soccorso impartitogli da Commissari, ardisca, contro le leggi del PRINCIPE e del TESTATORE, affittare o tutta, o in parte alcuna delle case stesse, né meno sotto alcun colore o pretesto introdurvi persone estranee ad abitarle; quali case, esecutivamente alle leggi suddette, devono essere abitate dai soli graziati, intendendosi che i trasgressori, che affittassero, introducessero, o non abitassero le medesime, non solo saranno illico privati della casa stessa, ma anche soggetti a tutte quell’altre pene afflittive che saranno credute da LORO SIGNORIE ECCELLENTISSIME.
Come pure, che non vi sia alcuna persona di che grado e condizione esser si voglia, che ardisca sotto alcun pretesto introdursi e trattenersi in detta CORTE detta di SAN MARCO, per ivi giocar a qualunque sorte di GIOCO, sussurrare, tumultuare, strepitare o in altro modo inquietare gli abitanti della CORTE medesima, con pena a chi contravverrà di PRIGIONE, CORDA, FRUSTA, GALERA, BERLINA, ed altre ad arbitrio della GIUSTIZIA, con TAGLIA all'ACCUSATORE, che sarà tenuto segreto, di LIRE DUECENTO DI PICCOLI dai beni del reo. E perché tanto è pia quanto è risoluta volontà di Loro ECCELLENZE, che il presente proclama resti in tutte le sue parti interamente obbedito, gli inobbedienti resteranno irremissibilmente puniti.
Data dal MAGISTRATO ECCELLENTISSIMO sopradetto il 13 SETTEMBRE 1759.

English Translation:
HOPE IN GOD. O reader, VICTOR SPERA restored these buildings – once bequeathed with her own money by LUCIA ADOLDA to the College and Fabric of Saints SIMON and JUDEA from a humble and now collapsing house – into this larger form which you now see. I did not wish you to be unaware of this matter. Farewell. 1520.
IT IS GOOD TO HOPE IN GOD. We were nurses to a boy, left with pious care, who, as a man, soon gave us these monuments. A great hope had grown in us from his character, yet he surpassed it, and thence took his name. For because he conquered hope, VICTOR by surname is SPERA. Gracious in his work towards us, towards the temples of the saints. Therefore, whoever reads, congratulate us, and may you attribute the desired prayers to gifts from heaven.
Italian Translation:
SPERA IN DIO. O lettore, VICTOR SPERA restaurò in questa più ampia forma che vedi questi edifici – un tempo legati con denaro proprio da LUCIA ADOLDA al Collegio e alla Fabbrica dei Santi SIMONE e GIUDEA, da una casa umile e ormai fatiscente. Non volli che tu fossi ignaro di questa cosa. Addio. 1520.
È BUONO SPERARE IN DIO. Fummo nutrici di un fanciullo, lasciato con pia cura, il quale, da uomo, presto ci diede questi monumenti. Dalla sua indole una grande speranza era cresciuta in noi, e tuttavia la superò, e da ciò trasse il suo nome. Infatti, poiché vinse la speranza, VICTOR di cognome è SPERA. Benigno nella sua opera verso di noi, verso i templi dei santi. Perciò, chiunque tu legga, rallegrati con noi, e ascrivi ai doni del cielo i voti desiderati che si realizzano.

Died prematurely at the age of fifty-two,

English Translation: THE MOST SERENE PRINCE MAKES KNOWN / AND IT IS, BY ORDER OF THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS AND EXCELLENT LORDS PROVEDITORI AL SAL, / AS THEY HAVE TOTAL JURISDICTION OVER THE ISLAND OF RIALTO, THAT IT IS THE RESOLVED AND FIRM INTENTION OF THEIR EXCELLENCIES THAT THE GREENGROCERS OF CHIOZA, PELESTRINA, MALAMOCO, SANTO ERASMO, VIGNOLE, ZVECCA, LIDO, TRE PORTI, AND OF THIS CITY, AND MVRAN, WHO COME TO SELL IN THIS CITY ON THE ISLAND OF RIALTO, SUBJECT TO THE MAGISTRACY OF THEIR EXCELLENCIES, IN THE STALLS ASSIGNED TO THE SAID GREENGROCERS WHICH ARE IN THE HERB MARKET CALLED PESCARIA VECCHIA, MAY DISPOSE OF THE GOODS THEY BRING FOR THE UNIVERSAL BENEFIT AND CONVENIENCE OF THE CITY, WITH ALL SECURITY, AND ARE NOT IMPROPERLY MOLESTED OR PREJUDICED BY ANY FRUIT SELLER, HERB SELLER, OR OTHER PERSON. IT IS PUBLICLY MADE KNOWN THAT WHOSOEVER DARES AT ANY TIME OF THE YEAR TO CAUSE HARM TO SAID GREENGROCERS, BY MAKING IT LAWFUL FOR THEMSELVES, AGAINST THE GREENGROCERS' WILL, TO ENTER THEIR BOATS AT THE BANKS OF SAID HERB MARKET, AND TO INTERFERE BY EATING OR TAKING GOODS BROUGHT BY THEM IN INDIRECT WAYS, AND NOT PAYING FOR THEM BEFORE REMOVING THEM FROM THOSE BOATS, SHALL BE SEVERELY PUNISHED WITH THE IRREMEDIABLE PENALTY OF THREE PULLS OF THE ROPE; AND IF UNABLE (TO ENDURE THIS), SHALL BE PLACED FOR ONE HOUR IN THE PILLORY, AND RECEIVE OTHER PUNISHMENTS AT THE DISCRETION OF THEIR EXCELLENCIES. IT IS APPROPRIATE THAT PERSONS WHO BRING PROVISIONS TO THIS CITY BE WELL TREATED. THEREFORE, THE GREENGROCERS THEMSELVES REMAIN OBLIGATED AND INSTRUCTED, IN CASE OF MOLESTATION, TO REPORT TO THE MAGISTRACY OF THEIR EXCELLENCIES, TO GIVE ACCOUNT AND NOTICE FOR THEIR PROPER RESOLUTIONS, UNDER PENALTY ALSO FOR THEM (THE GREENGROCERS) OF BEING CORRECTED AT THE DISCRETION OF THEIR EXCELLENCIES. AND THE PRESENT (EDICT) BE CARVED IN MARBLE STONE FOR THE CLEAR UNDERSTANDING OF EVERYONE. / GIVEN BY THE MOST EXCELLENT MAGISTRACY OF THE SAL, ON MARCH 13, 1688 / MARC ANTONIO PASQVALIGO P.R / PIETRO LOREDAN P.R / OTTAVIAN PISANI P.R / ANTONIO BOLLANI P.R / ON JUNE 10, 1688, PUBLISHED BY ME GIACOMO PALACIOL, COMMANDER OF THE SAID MOST EXCELLENT MAGISTRACY. / ILLARIO BONERI, AUDITOR, SAL CASSA RICOLA.

English Translation: RESOLUTION BY THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS AND EXCELLENT LORDS SAVI AND ESSECUTORI ALLE ACQUE, JUDGES DELEGATED BY THE MOST EXCELLENT SENATE AND APPROVED BY SAID MOST EXCELLENT SENATE. THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS AND EXCELLENT LORDS BATTA NANI, KNIGHT, PROCURATOR; ALVISE BARBARIGO, PROCURATOR; GEROLAMO BASADONA, SAVIO; BENEDETTO PISANI, PIETRO DONADO; AND BORTOLO CONTARINI, ESSECUTORI ALLE ACQUE. CONCERNING CERTAIN DISPUTES REGARDING FISHING BETWEEN THE INHABITANTS OF THE LAND OF MALAMOCCO, ON ONE SIDE, DEMANDING THAT THE CLAIMS OF THE POVEGGIOTTI IN THE AFOREMENTIONED FISHING BE CONFINED, AND ON THE OTHER SIDE, THE GASTALDO OF THE COMMUNITY OF THE ISLAND OF POVEGGIA, WHO IMPLORED THE CONTINUATION OF THEIR PRIVILEGE IN THIS MATTER. HAVING HEARD FROM HIS SERENITY AND THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS (MAGISTRATES) IN CONTRADICTION THEIR REASONS, AS WELL AS HAVING CONSIDERED THE PRIVILEGES AND HAVING REGARD FOR THE CURRENT STATE OF AFFAIRS, THEY HAVE DECIDED THAT FISHING BE GRANTED TO THE POVEGGIOTTI THEMSELVES IN THE AREAS SURROUNDING THE ISLAND ITSELF WITHIN THE BELOW-WRITTEN BOUNDARIES, NAMELY: TO THE EAST, THE CANAL OF SAN SPIRITO; TO THE SOUTH, THE CANAL OF POVEGGIA; TO THE WEST, THE CANAL DELLE STARTOLE AND THE CANAL DI REZA; AND TO THE NORTH, THE CANAL ORFANO. WHICH CANALS, HOWEVER, ARE TO REMAIN ALWAYS EXCLUDED, AS WITH THE OTHER CANALS, WATERS, OR MARSHES, THEY ARE TO REMAIN FOR COMMON BENEFIT, WITH THE CONDITION, HOWEVER, THAT THE POVEGGIOTTI THEMSELVES BE PERMITTED SIMPLE USE, NOT PROHIBITED BY LAWS AND IN THE ORDINARY FORMS, SO THAT AT NO TIME MAY THEY LEASE THE FISHING RIGHTS IN THE AFOREMENTIONED PLACES TO OTHERS, MAKE FISH FARMS, OR PLACE THE LAGOON IN ANY IMAGINABLE SERVITUDE, AS IS RIGHT. GIVEN BY THE MAGISTRATO ALLE ACQUE ON 2 AUGUST 1670. THEN, ON 23 AUGUST IN THE PREGADI, IT WAS APPROVED. ISEPO ZUCCATO, DUCAL NOTARY. UNDER THE ADMINISTRATION OF ZVANE SCARPA, SON OF CHIAROMONTE, AND OF THE LORDS FELICE MASSARI OF BOGNOLO, SON OF MARCO, AND MAG. VENETA.
Italian Translation: DELIBERAZIONE DEGLI ILLVSTRISSIMI ET ECCELLENTISSIMI SIGNORI SAVI ED ESECUTORI ALLE ACQUE, GIUDICI DELEGATI DALL'ECCELLENTISSIMO SENATO ED APPROVATA DA DETTO ECCELLENTISSIMO SENATO. GLI ILLVSTRISSIMI ET ECCELLENTISSIMI SIGNORI BATTA NANI CAVALIERE PROCURATORE, ALVISE BARBARIGO PROCURATORE, GEROLAMO BASADONA SAVIO, BENEDETTO PISANI, PIETRO DONADO E BORTOLO CONTARINI, ESECUTORI ALLE ACQUE. VERTENDO ALCUNE CONTESE PER OCCASIONE DI PESCA TRA GLI ABITANTI DELLA TERRA DI MALAMOCCO DA UNA PARTE, I QUALI CHIEDEVANO CHE FOSSERO CONFINATE LE PRETENSIONI DEI POVEGGIOTTI NELLE PESCHE SUDDETTE, E DALL'ALTRA IL GASTALDO DELL'UNIVERSITÀ DELL'ISOLA DI POVEGGIA, IL QUALE SUPPLICO' LA CONTINUAZIONE DEL LORO PRIVILEGIO IN QUESTO AFFARE. UDITE DA SUA SERENITÀ E DAGLI ILLVSTRISSIMI IN CONTRADDITTORIO LE LORO RAGIONI, COME PURE INTESI I PRIVILEGI ED AVUTO RISGUARDO ALLO STATO DELLE COSE PRESENTI, HANNO TERMINATO, CHE AI POVEGGIOTTI STESSI SIA CONCESSA LA PESCA NEI LUOGHI CIRCONVICINI ALL'ISOLA STESSA DENTRO GLI INFRASCRITTI CONFINI, CIOÈ: A LEVANTE IL CANAL DI SAN SPIRITO; A MEZZOGIORNO IL CANAL DI POVEGGIA; A PONENTE IL CANAL DELLE STARTOLE E IL CANAL DI REZA; E A TRAMONTANA IL CANAL ORFANO. I QUALI CANALI, PERÒ, RESTINO SEMPRE ESCLUSI, DOVENDO CON GLI ALTRI CANALI, ACQUE O PALUDI RESTARE A BENEFICIO COMUNE, CON LA CONDIZIONE PERÒ CHE SIA AI POVEGGIOTTI MEDESIMI PERMESSO SEMPLICE USO NON PROIBITO DALLE LEGGI E CON LE FORME ORDINARIE, COSICCHÉ IN ALCUN TEMPO NON POSSANO AD ALTRI AFFITTARE LE PESCHE NEI LUOGHI SOPRANOMINATI, FAR VALLI NÉ PORRE IN SERVITÙ IMMAGINABILE LA LAGUNA, COME È DI RAGIONE. DATA DAL MAGISTRATO ALLE ACQUE IL 2 AGOSTO 1670. POI IL 23 AGOSTO IN PREGADI FU APPROVATA. ISEPO ZUCCATO, NOTARO DUCALE. SOTTO L'AMMINISTRAZIONE DI ZVANE SCARPA, FU CHIAROMONTE, E DEI SIGNORI FELICE MASSARI DELLA BOGNOLO, FU MARCO, E DI MAG. VENETA.

English Translation:
CITY OF VENICE
A.N.P.I. FIAP AVL
MESSAGE FROM GEN. MARK CLARK
TO THE C.L.N., TO THE PIAZZA COMMAND
AND TO THE PEOPLE OF VENICE

English Translation:
SUPREME COMMAND
The war against Austria-Hungary, which, under the high command of H.M. THE KING, SUPREME LEADER of the Italian Army, inferior in number and means, began on May 24, 1915, and was waged with unshakeable faith and tenacious valor, uninterrupted and most arduous for 41 months, IS WON. The gigantic battle engaged on October 24 last, in which fifty-one Italian divisions, three British, two French, one CZECHOSLOVAK and one AMERICAN regiment took part against seventy-three Austro-Hungarian divisions, IS OVER. The lightning-fast, most daring advance of the TWENTY-NINTH Army Corps on TRENTO, blocking the retreat routes for the enemy armies of TRENTINO, which were overwhelmed to the west by the troops of the SEVENTH Army and to the east by those of the FIRST, SIXTH and FOURTH, determined yesterday the total collapse of the enemy front from the BRENTA to the TORRE; the irresistible impetus of the TWELFTH, EIGHTH, TENTH Armies and the Cavalry Divisions pushes the fleeing enemy further and further back into the plain. H.R.H. THE DUKE OF AOSTA rapidly advances at the head of his invincible THIRD Army, eager to return to the positions it had already victoriously conquered, which it had never lost. The AUSTRO-HUNGARIAN Army is annihilated; it suffered very severe losses in the fierce resistance of the first days, and in the pursuit, it lost enormous quantities of material of all kinds and almost entirely its stores and depots. It has so far left in our hands about three hundred thousand prisoners, with entire General Staffs, and no fewer than five thousand cannons. The remnants of what was one of the most powerful armies in the world are retreating in disorder and without hope up the valleys they had descended with proud confidence.
4 NOVEMBER 1918 DIAZ
To the shining eternal memory of our heroic combatants, this plaque, cast in enemy bronze, is offered by the WOMEN OF ITALY.

English Translation:
VENETIANS!
LONG LIVE VENICE!
THIS IS THE EXULTANT CRY OF ALL ITALY,
AND WITH THIS CRY ON MY LIPS, I ENTER YOUR CITY.
I AM SENT BY THAT KING WHOSE LIFE WAS CONSECRATED TO NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE, AND WHOSE VALOR ON THE BATTLEFIELDS IS MATCHED ONLY BY HIS LOYALTY; HIS ANCIENT AND GLORIOUS CROWN IS ADORNED WITH THE VOTE OF THE PEOPLE.
I COME TO A CITY SECOND TO NONE IN THE WORLD FOR ITS MEMORABLE ACHIEVEMENTS IN ARMS, POLITICS, SCIENCE, COMMERCE, AND ARTS. AND THIS CITY WAS MADE EVEN DEARER TO ITALY BY THE LONGING, THE PAINFUL ANXIETIES, THE TRIALS IT ENDURED, ITS NOBLE AND FIRM BEARING, AND THE REMEMBRANCE THAT FROM ITS ILLUSTRIOUS EXILE CAME THE POWERFUL WORD WHICH UNITED DIVERGENT OPINIONS FOR A SINGLE PURPOSE: UNITY AND MONARCHY.
I DEEPLY FEEL THE HONOR AND IMPORTANCE OF THE OFFICE ENTRUSTED TO ME: TO INITIATE FREE INSTITUTIONS AMONG YOU, WHO WITH A SPONTANEOUS VOTE ARE TO PRONOUNCE UPON YOUR FUTURE DESTINIES. AND FOR MY PART, I PROMISE YOU GOODWILL, ALACRITY, AND A PROFOUND SENSE OF MY DUTY, AND WITH CONFIDENCE, I INVOKE THAT WHICH IS MOST VALUABLE: YOUR ACTIVE COOPERATION. FOR IN FREE GOVERNMENTS, THE GOVERNMENT IS SHAPED BY THE WISDOM AND ACTIVITY OF ITS CITIZENS, AND ITS OPERATION AND VALUE ARE DIRECTLY PROPORTIONAL TO THEIR WORTH AND COOPERATION.
PEOPLES WHO, AFTER LONG STRUGGLES, RECLAIM THEIR INDEPENDENCE, IF THEY DIRECT THEIR ENERGY TOWARDS THE VARIOUS BRANCHES OF CIVIL PROGRESS, RAPIDLY ADVANCE TO PROSPERITY AND GREATNESS. THIS FACT IS REFLECTED IN YOUR GLORIOUS ANNALS, WHEN, HAVING REPELLED ENEMIES FROM THESE LAGOONS, THE WISDOM AND VIRTUE OF YOUR ANCESTORS AMAZED THE WORLD. THIS, I HOPE AND WISH, WILL BE RENEWED IN ITALY; IT WILL BE RENEWED IN VENICE, SO THAT SHE MAY REGAIN HER ANCIENT SPLENDOR IN A NEW FORM, AND ONE ALL THE MORE WORTHY, BECAUSE FROM IT THE ENTIRE NATION WILL SHINE AND BENEFIT.
VENICE, 20 OCTOBER 1866
THE KING'S COMMISSIONER
G PASOLINI
Italian Translation:
VENEZIANI!
VIVA VENEZIA!
QUESTO È IL GRIDO DI TUTTA ITALIA ESULTANTE
E CON QUESTO GRIDO SULLE LABBRA IO ENTRO NELLA VOSTRA CITTÀ.
M’INVIA QUEL RE, LA CUI VITA FU CONSACRATA ALLA INDIPENDENZA NAZIONALE, E IL CUI VALORE SUI CAMPI DI BATTAGLIA NON HA PARI CHE NELLA SUA LEALTÀ; L’ANTICA E GLORIOSA SUA CORONA S’INGEMMA DEL VOTO DEI POPOLI.
VENGO IN UNA CITTÀ A NIUN’ALTRA SECONDA NEL MONDO PER MEMORANDI FASTI DI ARMI, DI POLITICA, DI SCIENZA, DI COMMERCI, DI ARTI. E PIÙ CARA FECERO ALL’ITALIA QUESTA CITTÀ IL LUNGO DESIDERIO, LE PENOSE ANSIETÀ, I TRAVAGLI CHE ESSA DURÒ, IL SUO CONTEGNO SÌ NOBILE E FERMO, E LA RICORDANZA CHE DALL’ILLUSTRE SUO ESULE VENNE LA POTENTE PAROLA CHE LE OPINIONI DISCREPANTI RIUNÌ IN UN SOLO SCOPO: UNITÀ E MONARCHIA.
IO SENTO ALTAMENTE L’ONORE E LA IMPORTANZA DELL’UFFICIO COMMESSOMI D’ INIZIARE GLI ORDINI LIBERI TRA VOI, CHE CON SPONTANEO VOTO AVETE A PRONUNZIARE SULLE VOSTRE SORTI AVVENIRE. E DA MIA PARTE VI PROMETTO BUON VOLERE, ALACRITÀ E SENTIMENTO PROFONDO DEL MIO DOVERE, E CON FIDUCIA INVOCO, CIÒ CHE PIÙ VALE, IL VOSTRO OPEROSO CONCORSO. IMPEROCCHÉ NE’ REGGIMENTI LIBERI, IL GOVERNO S’INFORMA DEL SENNO E DELLA ATTIVITÀ DEI CITTADINI, E TANTO OPERA E VALE, QUANTO ESSI VALGONO E COOPERANO.
I POPOLI, CHE DOPO LUNGHE LOTTE RIVENDICANO LA PROPRIA INDIPENDENZA, SE VOLGONO LA LORO ENERGIA AI VARII RAMI DEL CIVILE PROGRESSO, RAPIDI CORRONO A PROSPERITÀ E GRANDEZZA. QUESTO FATTO HA RISCONTRO NEI VOSTRI GLORIOSI ANNALI, QUANDO RESPINTI GLI INIMICI DA QUESTE LAGUNE, LA SAPIENZA E LA VIRTÙ DEGLI AVI VOSTRI FECERO MARAVIGLIARE IL MONDO. QUESTO IO SPERO ED AUGURO SI RINNOVERÀ IN ITALIA; SI RINNOVERÀ A VENEZIA, ONDE ESSA RIACQUISTI IL SUO ANTICO SPLENDORE SOTTO FORMA NOVELLA, E TANTO PIÙ DEGNA, PERCHÉ NE RIFULGE E SI VANTAGGIA L’INTERA NAZIONE.
VENEZIA LI 20 OTTOBRE 1866
IL COMMISSARIO DEL RE
G PASOLINI

English Translation: THE MOST SERENE PRINCE MAKES KNOWN, AND IT IS BY DELIBERATION OF THE MOST ILLUSTRIOUS AND EXCELLENT LORDS EXECUTORS AGAINST BLASPHEMY, THAT NO PERSON, OF WHATEVER RANK OR CONDITION, NONE EXCEPTED, SHALL DARE HERE BENEATH THE CLOISTERS OF THE REVEREND FATHERS OF SAN STEFANO TO PLAY BALL, BALLOON, PANDOLO, CARDS, DICE, BOCCE, NOR ANY OTHER GAME, NONE EXCEPTED, NOR HERE TO CAUSE A TUMULT, SHOUT, OR PERFORM SCANDALOUS AND IMPROPER ACTS, UNDER PENALTY FOR TRANSGRESSORS OF ROPE, PRISON, WHIPPING, PILLORY, GALLEY, AND OTHER GREATER PENALTIES AT THE DISCRETION OF THEIR EXCELLENCIES. WITH A REWARD TO THE ACCUSER, WHO SHALL BE KEPT SECRET, OF TWO HUNDRED SMALL LIRE FROM THE CULPRIT'S GOODS. IT IS ALSO EXPRESSLY FORBIDDEN TO ANY PERSON, NONE EXCEPTED, TO SELL GOODS OR MERCHANDISE OF ANY KIND. THE CURRENT SACRISTAN OF THE CHURCH AND THOSE WHO SHALL BE SACRISTANS FOR THE TIME BEING ARE HELD RESPONSIBLE FOR VIGILANCE SO THAT MERCHANDISE AND GOODS AS AFORESAID ARE NOT SOLD, AND SHOULD THEY ENCOUNTER ANYONE WHO, IN DEFIANCE OF THE PRESENT PROCLAMATION, DARES TO SELL THEM, THEY MUST REPORT THE INFORMATION TO THEIR EXCELLENCIES, AND THIS UNDER ALL THOSE PENALTIES FOR THE AFOREMENTIONED SACRISTANS THAT SHALL SEEM MOST APPROPRIATE TO JUSTICE. GIVEN BY THE AFORESAID MAGISTRACY ON 17 MARCH 1705. FRANC° MARIA GIVSTINIAN, EXECUTOR. PIETRO FOSCARINI, EXECUTOR. ALVISE PISANI, EXECUTOR. ZVANE CORNARO, EXECUTOR. ANTONIO CANAL, NOTARY. 288.
Italian Translation: IL SERENISSIMO PRINCIPE FA SAPERE ED È PER DELIBERAZIONE DEGLI ILLUSTRISSIMI ED ECCELLENTISSIMI SIGNORI ESECUTORI CONTRO LA BESTEMIA CHE NON VI SIA ALCUNA PERSONA, DI QUALSIASI GRADO O CONDIZIONE ESSERE SI VOGLIA, NESSUNA ECCETTUATA, CHE ARDISCA QUI SOTTO I CHIOSTRI DEI REVERENDI PADRI DI SAN STEFANO DI GIOCARE A PALLA, PALLONE, PANDOLO, CARTE, DADI, BOCCE NÉ A QUALSIASI ALTRO GIOCO, NESSUNO ECCETTUATO, NÉ QUI TUMULTUARE, STREPITARE, FARE ATTI SCANDALOSI ED IMPROPRI SOTTO PENA AI TRASGRESSORI DI CORDA, PRIGIONE, FRUSTA, BERLINA, GALERA ED ALTRE MAGGIORI AD ARBITRIO DELLE LORO ECCELLENZE. CON TAGLIA ALL'ACCUSATORE, IL QUALE SARÀ TENUTO SEGRETO, DI DUECENTO LIRE PICCOLE DAI BENI DEL REO. STIVANELLO GUSSONI PAOLO – SECOND LIEUTENANT OF THE 2ND GRENADIER REGIMENT. AT A VERY SHORT DISTANCE FROM THE ENEMY,

UNDER THE INTENSE FIRE OF ENEMY MACHINE GUNS.

STIVANELLO GUSSONI PAOLO – CAPTAIN OF THE 2ND GRENADIER REGIMENT.

FOR THE DEFINITIVE CONQUEST OF AN IMPORTANT POSITION, AFTER
HAVING, WITH HIS EXAMPLE, KEPT HIS TROOPS FIRM
UNDER A BOMBARDMENT OF EXTREME VIOLENCE THAT DECIMATED THEM,
WHEN THE OPPORTUNE MOMENT ARRIVED, SPRINGING FIRST
FROM THE ENTRENCHMENT, HE CARRIED THEM WITH SUBLIME, IRRESISTIBLE
IMPETUS TO VICTORY. HIT SQUARELY BY THE EXPLOSION OF
A LARGE CALIBER SHELL, HE DID NOT CEASE TO INCITE HIS
MEN UNTIL HE BREATHED HIS LAST – MONTE S. MICHELE –
PEAK 2 – AUGUST 8, 1915 – SILVER MEDAL –
STIVANELLO GUSSONI GIORGIO – ARTILLERY LIEUTENANT,
AVIATOR PILOT, 121ST AIR SQUADRON. AN OFFICER OF
PROVEN TECHNICAL COMPETENCE, HIGH PATRIOTIC SENSE, AND OF
NOBLE MILITARY VIRTUES, HE VOLUNTEERED MULTIPLE TIMES FOR DIFFICULT
ASSIGNMENTS AND TOUGH CHALLENGES. REFUSING TO BE REMOVED FROM THE
FRONT, FOR THE STUDIES AND SCIENTIFIC APPLICATIONS HE WAS ENGAGED IN,
HE WISHED TO ACTIVELY PARTICIPATE IN THE FIGHT IN DARING
FLIGHTS, IN ONE OF WHICH, AFTER HAVING DIRECTED ARTILLERY FIRE WITH EXPERTISE AND
EFFECTIVENESS, HE FOUND GLORIOUS DEATH.

English Translation:
SUPREME COMMAND
4 NOVEMBER 1918
THE WAR AGAINST AUSTRIA-HUNGARY WHICH, UNDER THE HIGH LEADERSHIP OF H.M. THE KING SUPREME LEADER, THE ITALIAN ARMY, INFERIOR IN NUMBERS AND MEANS, BEGAN ON 24 MAY 1915 AND, WITH UNSHAKEABLE FAITH AND TENACIOUS VALOUR, CONDUCTED WITHOUT INTERRUPTION AND WITH EXTREME HARSHNESS FOR 41 MONTHS, IS WON. THE GIGANTIC BATTLE ENGAGED ON THE 24TH OF LAST OCTOBER, AND IN WHICH 51 ITALIAN DIVISIONS, 3 BRITISH, 2 FRENCH, 1 CZECHOSLOVAK AND 1 AMERICAN REGIMENT TOOK PART AGAINST 73 AUSTRO-HUNGARIAN DIVISIONS, IS OVER. THE LIGHTNING-FAST, EXTREMELY AUDACIOUS ADVANCE OF THE 29TH ARMY CORPS ON TRENTO, BLOCKING THE RETREAT ROUTES FOR THE ENEMY ARMIES OF TRENTINO, OVERWHELMED TO THE WEST BY THE TROOPS OF THE SEVENTH ARMY AND TO THE EAST BY THOSE OF THE FIRST, SIXTH AND FOURTH, DETERMINED YESTERDAY THE TOTAL COLLAPSE OF THE ADVERSARY FRONT FROM THE BRENTA TO THE TORRE; THE IRRESISTIBLE IMPETUS OF THE TWELFTH, EIGHTH, TENTH ARMIES AND OF THE CAVALRY DIVISIONS PUSHES THE FLEEING ENEMY EVER FURTHER BACK INTO THE PLAIN. H.R.H. THE DUKE OF AOSTA ADVANCES RAPIDLY AT THE HEAD OF HIS INVINCIBLE THIRD ARMY, LONGING TO RETURN TO THE POSITIONS IT HAD ALREADY VICTORIOUSLY CONQUERED, WHICH IT HAD NEVER LOST. THE AUSTRO-HUNGARIAN ARMY IS ANNIHILATED; IT SUFFERED VERY HEAVY LOSSES IN THE FIERCE RESISTANCE OF THE FIRST DAYS AND IN THE PURSUIT IT LOST ENORMOUS QUANTITIES OF MATERIAL OF ALL KINDS AND ALMOST ENTIRELY ITS STORES AND DEPOTS. IT HAS LEFT SO FAR IN OUR HANDS ABOUT THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND PRISONERS WITH ENTIRE GENERAL STAFFS AND NO LESS THAN FIVE THOUSAND CANNONS. THE REMNANTS OF WHAT WAS ONE OF THE MOST POWERFUL ARMIES IN THE WORLD ASCEND IN DISORDER AND WITHOUT HOPE THE VALLEYS THEY HAD DESCENDED WITH PROUD CONFIDENCE.
DIAZ

English Translation:
PAVLUS VENETUS, Prior, undertook the restoration of this church, dedicated to the Princes of the Apostles, already decaying with age and almost collapsing, under venerable patronage, himself newly devoted not so much to the administration of temporal affairs as to the cultivation of piety and religion, having it reformed with greater care in the Year of Christ 1603, during the reign of Doge FRANCESCO MOLINO, with the Most Illustrious and Most Excellent ALOYSIO MOCENIGO and ANDREA DELPHINO as patrons of this hospital.

The building having been repaired again, the old inscription was restored in 1736, during the reign of Doge ALOYSIO PISANI, with the Curators from the Patrician Order: IO. PETRO PASCHALICO, IO. ANTONIO RUZZINO, GEORGIO CONTARENO, Knight Commander of JOPPE, and from the Citizen Order: FRANCISCO CAVALLI, IOSEPHO AGAZZI, and IO. BAPTISTA ALBERGHINI, President.
Italian Translation:
Questa chiesa, dedicata ai Principi degli Apostoli, già fatiscente per la vecchiaia e quasi prossima al crollo, PAVLUS VENETUS, Priore, ne intraprese il restauro sotto venerabile patrocinio, egli stesso novellamente dedito non tanto all'amministrazione degli affari quanto alla coltivazione della pietà e della religione, affinché fosse riformata con maggiore cura nell'anno di Cristo 1603, sotto il Doge FRANCESCO MOLINO, con gli Illustrissimi ed Eccellentissimi ALOYSIO MOCENIGO e ANDREA DELPHINO come tutori di questo ospedale.

Essendo stato nuovamente restaurato l'edificio, l'antica epigrafe fu restituita nel 1736, sotto il Doge ALOYSIO PISANI, con i Curatori dell'Ordine Patrizio: IO. PETRO PASCHALICO, IO. ANTONIO RUZZINO, GEORGIO CONTARENO, Cavaliere Commendatore di GIOPE, e dall'Ordine Cittadino: FRANCISCO CAVALLI, IOSEPHO AGAZZI, e IO. BAPTISTA ALBERGHINI, Presidente.

English Translation:
(front)
TO THE NAVAL ARMADA (ORDER OF THE DAY OF 22 MARCH 1919)
THE ENEMY FLEET, CONSTANTLY AVOIDING BATTLE, HAS RECOGNIZED IN THE MOST COMPLETE AND EVIDENT MANNER THE EFFICIENCY OF THE ARMADA AND OF THE ALLIED UNITS THAT MAINTAINED DOMINION OF THE ADRIATIC.
THE ENEMY WAS ABLE TO AVOID COMBAT, BUT NOT THE SURRENDER AND DISARMAMENT OF ITS FLEET.
WE HAVE THUS OBTAINED THE MOST DECISIVE VICTORY EVER POSSIBLE TO ACHIEVE, AND THE IMPORTANCE OF THIS IS BY NO MEANS DIMINISHED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCE OF NOT HAVING ACHIEVED IT BY FIGHTING.
A PART OF THAT FLEET WHICH FOR FORTY MONTHS WE WAITED FOR IN VAIN IN THE OPEN SEA ARRIVES TODAY IN VENICE; AND IN THE HISTORIC CITY, THE GLORY OF THE NAVY THAT CONTAINED MUSLIM BARBARISM, IS UNITED WITH THE GLORY OF ITS NATURAL HEIR – THE NAVY OF THE NEW ITALY – WHICH IN THE SAME SEA HAS CONTAINED THE THREAT OF ANOTHER BARBARISM.
TO THE WORK, OF WHICH THE NATION NOW SEES THE TANGIBLE RESULT, ADMIRALS, COMMANDERS, OFFICERS AND CREWS, HAVE BROUGHT THE HIGHEST CONTRIBUTION, KEEPING THE FLEET ALWAYS READY TO ENTER INTO ACTION, PRESERVING INTACT, FOR FORTY MONTHS OF HARASSING WAITING, THE COMBATIVE ARDOR AND THE SENTIMENT OF DISCIPLINE THAT ANIMATED THEM ON THE DAY OF THE DECLARATION OF WAR.
AND FOR THIS WE HAVE WON.
THAON DI REVEL

(left side)

IMPERIAL AND ROYAL VICE ADMIRAL

TODAY IT IS A SYMBOLIC GIFT FROM THE SAILORS OF ITALY TO THE QUEEN OF THE ADRIATIC IN MEMORY OF COMRADES WHO FELL FOR THE REDEMPTION OF OUR SEA.

English Translation: On the fifteenth day of April 1816, the third Easter Feria, annually designated for administering the SACRED VIATICUM, comfort for the sick. On which occasion, by ancient custom, the MOST HOLY EUCHARIST is exposed upon an altar erected for this purpose, for the adoration of the artisans of the IMPERIAL-ROYAL ARSENAL. FRANZ I, EMPEROR AND KING, our MOST CLEMENT SOVEREIGN, being present there, after he too had humbly adored it, uniting with the people with great edification, accompanied it to the SACRED TEMPLE. The reverent artisans wished to perpetuate the grateful memory of this religious and solemn act. This plaque, removed by the Austrians in 1866 and taken to Pola, was returned to Venice on March 24, 1919, a day on which the former Austrian ships, constituting the token of our complete victory, arrived there.

DUCA D’AOSTA / AVANZA RAPIDAMENTE ALLA TESTA DELLA SUA INVITTA TERZA
ARMATA ANELANTE DI RITORNARE / SULLE POSIZIONI DA ESSA GIÀ VITTORIOSA-

CO È ANNIENTATO, ESSO HA SUBITO PERDITE GRAVISSIME NELLA / ACCANITA
RESISTENZA DEI PRIMI GIORNI E NELL’INSEGUIMENTO HA PERDUTE QUANTITÀ /
INGENTISSIME DI MATERIALE DI OGNI SORTA E PRESSOCHÉ PER INTERO I SUOI
MAGAZZINI / E I DEPOSITI. HA LASCIATO FINORA NELLE NOSTRE MANI CIRCA
TRECENTOMILA PRIGIONIERI / CON INTERI STATI MAGGIORI E NON MENO DI CIN-
QUEMILA CANNONI. I RESTI DI QUELLO CHE FU / UNO DEI PIÙ POTENTI ESERCITI
DEL MONDO RISALGONO IN DISORDINE E SENZA SPERANZA / LE VALLI CHE AVE-
VANO DISCESO CON ORGOGLIOSA SICUREZZA.

English Translation: THE MOST SERENE PRINCE makes known, and it is by deliberation of the MOST ILLUSTRIOUS AND EXCELLENT EXECUTORS AGAINST BLASPHEMY, that no person, of whatever rank, status, or condition they may be, shall dare to play any game whatsoever, in the CHURCH AND MONASTERY OF THE NUNS OF THE HOLY SPIRIT of this City and surrounding places, nor there to make noise, cause a disturbance, or perform other acts that may cause scandal. SOTTO PENA, PER I CONTRAFFATTORI, DI BANDO, PRIGIONE, GALERA, FRUSTA, BERLINA E ALTRE A ARBITRIO; LE QUALI SARANNO ANCHE IRREMISSIBILMENTE DATE A QUELLI CHE ARDIRANNO PROFERIRE QUALUNQUE BESTEMIA O PAROLE DI OBSCENITÀ CONTRO L'USO DEL VIVERE MODESTO, CON TAGLIA ALL'ACCUSATORE (IL QUALE SARÀ TENUTO SEGRETO) DI DUECENTO LIRE PICCOLE DAI BENI DEI DELINQUENTI. 25 APRILE 1653. GIÕ. PISANI, CARLO CONTARINI ESECUTORI CONTRO LA BESTEMIA, ANTONIO LONGO, GIACOMO DONÀ, GIÕ. PAVLO BONOMO SEGRETARIO.

English Translation: To NAVPOLEONI I, EMPEROR of the FRENCH, KING of ITALY; and likewise to EUGENE NAVPOLEONI, PRINCE, Adopted Son of NAVPOLEONI I, VICEROY of ITALY: because the former decreed that a house be prepared and opened in VENICE at ROYAL expense for educating and instructing the youth, and the latter here ordered that these commands be carried out; and MARCO SERBELLONI, KNIGHT, PREFECT of the ADRIATIC PROVINCE, diligently complying and urging with the utmost care, brought it to completion very quickly in the year 1807. This monument of honor and praise, worn away by age, the teachers took care to have restored in the year 1902.
Italian Translation: A NAVPOLEONI I, IMPERATORE dei FRANCESI, RE d'ITALIA; e parimenti a EUGENIO NAVPOLEONI, PRINCIPE, Figlio Adottivo di NAVPOLEONI I, VICERÉ d'ITALIA: in quanto il primo decretò che a VENEZIA fosse preparata e aperta una casa a Spese Regie per l'educazione e l'istruzione dei giovani, e il secondo qui ordinò che tali comandi fossero eseguiti; e MARCO SERBELLONI, CAVALIERE, PREFETTO della PROVINCIA ADRIATICA, che obbedì diligentemente e insistette con la massima cura, la portò a termine molto rapidamente nell'anno 1807. Un monumento d'onore e di lode, logorato dal tempo, i precettori si curarono di farlo restaurare nell'anno 1902.
